setting: Mio's bedroom and living room on a snowy winter night; warm pajamas or knit indoor clothes

sentences.english: On a winter night, my family sits in front of the stove, each reading a book.
sentences.japanese: 冬の夜、家族みんなでストーブの前に座って、それぞれが本を読んでいます。

sentences.english: It is important for all students to read a little every day.
sentences.japanese: 生徒はみんな、毎日少しずつでも本を読むことが大切です。

sentences.english: It is not easy for my brother to learn new words.
sentences.japanese: 兄が新しい単語を覚えるのは、簡単ではありません。

sentences.english: But he keeps trying, and he is getting strong.
sentences.japanese: でも、あきらめずに続けていて、だんだん強くなってきています。

sentences.english: It is still difficult for my sister to read long English sentences.
sentences.japanese: 妹にとって、長い英文を読むのはまだ難しい。

sentences.english: Even so, she tries a little every night.
sentences.japanese: それでも、毎晩少しずつがんばっています。

sentences.english: For our family, this quiet reading time is necessary now.
sentences.japanese: うちの家族にとって、この静かな読書の時間は、今とても必要なものなんです。

sentences.english: “Is it hard for you to speak English?” Tom asked me quietly.
sentences.japanese: 「英語を話すのって、難しい?」とトムが静かに聞いてくれました。

sentences.english: “Yes, but it is very important for me to try,” I answered firmly.
sentences.japanese: 「うん、でも挑戦することがわたしには大事なんだ」としっかり答えました。
